training_duration.schedule_source: exact frozen Level 3B 120-block sequence; class labels only schedule teacher events

dan_stimulation.pulse_onset: the tick at which the moving note reaches the arm trigger position
dan_stimulation.activity_gate: first spike from at least one stimulated DAN with an anatomical KC contact

action_output_validity_repair.valid_after: first MBON05 sample with voltage strictly above its zero-mV resting baseline; raw KC spikes alone do not enable output
action_output_validity_repair.readout_after_validity: unchanged Level 4B readout: maximum MBON05 voltage among valid samples in each 0.05-position bin; action iff that maximum is <= the inherited threshold
action_output_validity_repair.first_action_position: position-bin center of the earliest action bin in trajectory order
action_output_validity_repair.first_action_time: time of the last valid sample in that bin, when its frozen maximum-voltage decision is available
action_output_validity_repair.pre_sensory_bins: disabled when they contain no valid MBON05 samples

eligibility_locality_repair.window_rule: at the first connected DAN spike, include KC spikes from the current note with times in [DAN spike time - 50000 us, DAN spike time], inclusive; earlier spikes receive zero eligibility
eligibility_locality_repair.basis: At the frozen 500-ms traversal, 50 ms spans 0.10 normalized position; the saved pre-repair note has 3 unique-KC spikes in the final 50 ms for each teaching crossing, while 75 ms includes activity outside the taught-region halo.
eligibility_locality_repair.tau_status: unchanged inherited exponential decay inside the hard locality window
eligibility_locality_repair.reset: at the start and end of each note

learning.rule: same presentation-local LocalLTD rule and update formula
learning.commit: at note end; updated weights first affect the next note
learning.anatomical_gate: update KC slot only for positive current-window eligibility and an active, anatomically connected ensemble DAN

arms: target teaching: target-class notes, DAN pulse at x=0.70, plasticity on
wrong-region teaching: wrong-region-class notes, DAN pulse at x=0.20, plasticity on
matched DAN-on/plasticity-off control: target-class notes, DAN pulse at x=0.70, plasticity off
protocol.post_training_evaluation: one fresh 500-ms note per arm, DAN OFF, plasticity OFF, final weights retained
predeclared_pass_criteria: naive baseline has no first action
target-trained first action is in [0.65,0.75] and persists with DAN/plasticity off
wrong-region-trained first action is in [0.15,0.25] and persists with DAN/plasticity off
matched DAN-on/plasticity-off weights remain unchanged and have no first action
action output remains disabled until MBON05 shows a nonzero sensory response
no action occurs before MBON05 output validity
all updates have positive eligibility inside the frozen 50-ms note-local window and an active anatomically connected DAN
all weights remain at or above 20% of immutable original weights
all 120 blocks and 1200 presentations complete in all arms
protocol.stop_rule: one final run only; no parameter tuning or follow-up search; stop Level 4 after this run

scope: final Level 4 moving-note learning experiment; no osu timing scoring or biological downstream motor neurons
